reply_text:
Running all four personas on Kimi with images. First I'll write a small Playwright helper so every visitor sees the page as a browser renders it.Three Kimi seats are idle (象 is busy), so I'll register a fourth and dispatch through `kimi-task.sh`.The four Kimi runs are going, and the reports aren't in yet. The seats are already taking screenshots.

| Seat | Persona | Excursion |
|---|---|---|
| kimi-1 | Strategist (calibration) | E-kimi-task-131 |
| kimi-2 | Skimmer, phone, first screen only | E-kimi-task-132 |
| kimi-3 | CTO | E-kimi-task-133 |
| kimi-4 | Solo operator (new seat) | E-kimi-task-134 |

**What's the same as the Zai runs:** the personas and protocols, and the same output file with one section added, "The pictures". It asks what each image or demo shows, whether the persona could make sense of it, and whether it raised or lowered their trust.

**What's different:** they reach pages only through `visit.js`, a small Playwright script in the run folder. It renders each page in a real browser and saves one screenshot per screenful, plus the visible text and the visible links. So the commented-out list can't appear, and they look at screenshots with `view_image` instead of reading captions. The skimmer gets a phone-sized viewport; the others get laptop size. They can look at the zone demos but not click around inside them.

**Dispatch:**
- Everything went through `kimi-task.sh`, which sent the bells in work mode and committed four excursion files to futon2.
- When each job finishes, I'll check its report file exists, then mark its excursion completed (`--complete`).
- Output goes to `storage/futon7a/customer-sims/2026-09-29-kimi/`.

**One thing I can't enforce:** the helper saves every screenful, so the skimmer's rule of looking only at the first screen depends on it following instructions. I'll check its path section for that.
